CategoryEntry.description:
One node of the owned food category tree, as a flat row.

``parent_slug`` is ``None`` for L1 roots; children reference their parent's
slug, so the tree is reconstructible without nesting. Any level's slug is
accepted as ``/v1/search?category=`` (the match covers the whole subtree).

CoverageCountry.description:
One market's row in the public landing-page coverage feed.

Country-level aggregates are deliberately omitted: ``products`` is the
sum and freshness the min over ``retailer_list``, derivable client-side.

CoverageRetailer.description:
One retailer source's row in the public landing-page coverage feed.

``products`` counts only indexed grocery products (approved food
classifications), not raw scraped rows.
CoverageRetailer.title: CoverageRetailer

MeResponse.title: MeResponse

PriceHistoryResponse.description:
Aggregated price history for one retailer product over a date range.

``id`` is the product's opaque public identifier (``rp_<hex>``, the same
token a :class:`SearchHit` carries). Stats are pooled across every store
carrying the product; ``store_count`` tells the caller how many stores
contributed. ``change``/`change_pct`` are ``last - first`` relative to the
first observation in the window. All stats fields are ``None`` when the
product has no observations in range.
PriceHistoryResponse.title: PriceHistoryResponse

PriceObservation.description:
One raw observation row (product x store x scrape), unmodified.

The raw tier of the prices surface: no aggregation, no rounding — prices
arrive at stored precision. ``store_id`` is the store's opaque public
token (``st_<hex>``), the stable grouping key across observations.
PriceObservation.title: PriceObservation

PriceObservationsResponse.description:
Raw price observations for one product over a date range, paginated.

Ordered by ``observed_at`` ascending (tiebreak: store). Same pagination
shape as ``SearchResponse``: ``found`` is the total match count for the
window, not the page size.
PriceObservationsResponse.title: PriceObservationsResponse

info.description:
Product & price search across EU grocery retailers. All endpoints are GET-only, mounted under `/v1`.

**Authentication.** Every route except `/health`, `/v1/coverage`, `/v1/categories`, and `/v1/tags` requires an `X-API-Key` header (fail-closed: a missing, invalid, or revoked key is rejected with `401`). Every error body carries a stable `error.code` token to branch on — never the message.

**Credits & limits.** Each key has a monthly credit cap (default 10,000; per-consumer overrides exist) replenished on a rolling 30-day window. Successful billed responses carry `X-Credits-Remaining`; `GET /v1/me` returns the live balance and window reset, free of charge. Bursts are throttled per key at 300 requests/minute by default (per-key overrides apply; the shared free key is limited per client IP). Exceeding the window gets `429` with `Retry-After` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining` — and never burns a credit.

Per-endpoint credit costs:

| Endpoint | Credits |
|---|---|
| `/health` | 0 |
| `/v1/me` | 0 |
| `/v1/prices/{product_id}` | 1 |
| `/v1/prices/{product_id}/observations` | 1 |
| `/v1/products/{product_id}` | 1 |
| `/v1/search` | 1 |
info.title: mealcp search API
